mechanism: Both drugs can cause hyperkalemia and renal dysfunction; captopril inhibits aldosterone while sirolimus impairs renal function and increases potassium retention, with additive nephrotoxic effects.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function (creatinine, eGFR) regularly; consider potassium-sparing diuretic avoidance and dietary potassium restriction; adjust doses based on renal function.
